Under the owner-confirmed skipped-line rule (adjudication README) a nonzero amount shown on a worksheet the filer never reaches is a defect of the side that shows it. The published interface offered shown_when ("a Bool line of the same document") and sd.line17 (Bool), so the source reading was expressible. Project stands.
